usage: Save as csv_records.py after operator review. Requires Python 3 and only the standard library. Run: python3 csv_records.py < input.json. Input must be one JSON object containing text and delimiter (comma, semicolon, or tab). Alternatively import convert_csv and pass that object directly. The first CSV record supplies case-sensitive, unique headers; every subsequent record must have exactly the same width. Values remain strings, preserving Unicode, empty fields, whitespace, and quoted newlines. Extra columns are retained when declared in the header. Parsing errors, duplicate headers, width mismatches, or schema violations return {"error":"invalid_input"} without partial records. Empty input and header-only input return {"records":[]}; blank CSV records are rejected. Empty header names are allowed if unique. Source has not been executed.
